data.name: RichTextBox1.Text
data.value: Multidimensional (2D) Arrays Concept & Layout: • Stores data in a Table format (Rows & Columns). • Requires two subscripts: (Row, Column). • Both Row and Column indices are 0-based. Declaration Syntax: • Dim name(MaxRow, MaxCol) As DataType • Dim scores(2, 3) As Integer -> 3 Rows (0..2), 4 Columns (0..3) -> Total Elements = (2 + 1) * (3 + 1) = 12 Accessing Values: • scores(0, 0) = 85 ' Row 0, Col 0 • scores(2, 3) = 99 ' Bottom-right slot

data.value:
2D Array Memory Structure: scores(2, 3) Col 0 Col 1 Col 2 Col 3 Row 0: (0, 0) (0, 1) (0, 2) (0, 3) Row 1: (1, 0) (1, 1) (1, 2) (1, 3) Row 2: (2, 0) (2, 1) (2, 2) (2, 3)
Traversing via Nested Loops: For r As Integer = 0 To 2 For c As Integer = 0 To 3 scores(r, c) = 0 Next Next
• Outer Loop = Rows | Inner Loop = Columns
